name: gantt-settings-reordering
title: Settings menu, row reordering and scheduling
description: Settings menu, row reordering and scheduling. Core/Planning/Gantt pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/core/Gantt and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:g-udi/design-system.
